executive_summary.project_identity: EverythingAI / EverythingApp is a local-first AI-powered file brain that indexes local files, extracts document content, supports search/chat, generates source-backed Wikipedia-style knowledge pages, and safely supports governed file organization workflows.
executive_summary.current_phase: Local MVP user experience hardening, with strong focus on source-backed Wiki / Knowledge Base quality.
executive_summary.latest_confirmed_direction: The Wiki must behave like a content-first encyclopedia/book/blog reader built from the actual content inside local documents, PDFs, books, spreadsheets, images, and other indexed files. Metadata must be secondary, not dominant.
executive_summary.current_bottleneck: The backend foundation is strong; the remaining bottleneck is polished product UX, source precision, persisted wiki architecture, and maintainable frontend component structure.
executive_summary.handover_timing_reason: Context is large and the project reached a stable milestone: Wiki direction confirmed, major UI/UX pieces working, and next work requires careful architecture decisions.

recent_implementation_milestones.summary: Added backend Wiki routes and generator, then iterated from minimal metadata-heavy pages to content-first pages based on extracted document content.
Added Wiki tab, article rendering, source rail, category/topic/file page navigation, and styles.
Added search inside the Wiki Knowledge Map, ranking title/category/topic/summary/full article/source filenames/source paths/evidence snippets.
Added Reading Mode and clickable wiki-style [[Related Page]] links in article body.
Added user toast bus/provider/viewport and API-level success/error notifications for user-triggered actions.
Added backend route to reveal source file in the local OS file manager and wired UI source actions.

Backend Wiki generator now creates chunk-level references such as [S1:C3], Source Locations, chunk line ranges, character ranges, and evidence snippets. Frontend badge rendering for these chunk refs is not fully completed yet.

current_wiki_knowledge_base_status.direction: Confirmed by user as correct and improving.
current_wiki_knowledge_base_status.core_principle: Wiki pages must prioritize real document/file content. Metadata and technical system details should be minimized or moved lower on the page.
implemented_capabilities: Build Wiki from indexed/extracted local files
Topic pages across multiple related files
File pages based on extracted document content
Knowledge Map tree organized by category/topic/source file pages
Intelligent Wiki search with ranked results
Markdown/article rendering with headings, tables, bold, italic, blockquotes, source markers, and related links
Initial chunk-level citation generation in backend
known_limitations: Wiki pages are currently generated live/in-memory from existing data; they are not yet persisted as wiki_pages/wiki_sections/wiki_sources tables.
Category/topic generation is still partly rule-based and should become more AI/embedding-driven.
Chunk-level citations are generated in backend markdown but frontend badge rendering/click behavior for [S1:C3] still needs finishing.
Citations do not yet open a source preview or scroll to a specific source chunk.
PDF page numbers are not yet reliable because extraction currently works mainly from text extraction output, not a rich page-aware extraction model.
Images/tables/charts from PDFs/Excel are not yet richly extracted and embedded into wiki article sections.
UserApp.tsx is too large and should be split soon.

latest_known_issue_and_next_fix.issue: Frontend rendering for chunk citation markers [S1:C3] was attempted but not completed cleanly because UserApp.tsx is large and a tool payload/update issue interrupted the update.
latest_known_issue_and_next_fix.backend_status: Chunk-level citations are generated in services/api/src/knowledge/knowledgeService.js and appear in wiki markdown after rebuilding Wiki.
latest_known_issue_and_next_fix.frontend_status: UserApp.tsx currently needs a small targeted update: renderInlineMarkdown regex should support [S1:C3] in addition to [S1], and optionally make citation badges clickable later.

recommended_next_action.change: Find renderInlineMarkdown() and change citation regex from only [S\d+] to [S\d+(?::C\d+)?]. Ensure chunk refs render with class wiki-source-ref.
recommended_next_action.test: Run npm run typecheck and npm run build in apps/everything-ai-ui, then rebuild Wiki and confirm [S1:C3] shows as citation badge.

recommended_next_implementation_sequence.title: Finish chunk citation rendering
recommended_next_implementation_sequence.details: Render [S1:C3] as citation badges, not plain text. Keep [S1] support.

recommended_next_implementation_sequence.title: Make citations clickable
recommended_next_implementation_sequence.details: Click [S1:C3] to highlight/scroll to Source Locations entry or open a source preview panel/modal. Do not overbuild until chunk rendering is validated.

recommended_next_implementation_sequence.title: Split UserApp.tsx
recommended_next_implementation_sequence.details: Move Wiki view, Ask view, Explore view, MarkdownArticle, source rail, and setup/onboarding pieces into smaller components. This is important because UserApp.tsx is now too large and risky to patch.

recommended_next_implementation_sequence.title: Persist Wiki pages and source chunks in SQLite
recommended_next_implementation_sequence.details: Add wiki_pages, wiki_page_sections, wiki_page_sources, wiki_source_chunks, wiki_page_relations. This will support versioning, search, incremental rebuilds, and stable source references.

recommended_next_implementation_sequence.title: Improve AI topic/category generation
recommended_next_implementation_sequence.details: Move from mostly rule-based category generation toward AI/embedding-assisted clustering. Keep deterministic fallback.

recommended_next_implementation_sequence.title: Improve document reading quality
recommended_next_implementation_sequence.details: Better heading detection, remove headers/footers, remove duplicates/OCR artifacts, preserve document hierarchy, create clean chapter/section reading surfaces.

recommended_next_implementation_sequence.title: Add richer table/image/chart handling
recommended_next_implementation_sequence.details: Detect tables from CSV/XLSX and render them. Later extract PDF images/screenshots and display through safe preview routes.

recommended_next_implementation_sequence.title: Add build progress stages
recommended_next_implementation_sequence.details: Build Wiki and Build Knowledge should report stages/progress, not only final toast.

known_risks: UserApp.tsx is large and patching it as a full file is now error-prone. Split it before major additional UI work.
Docs still include historical/legacy UI files and older phase language. Next agent should not blindly follow old services/api/public UI docs for current user UI work.
Wiki generation is not yet persisted, so generated pages may be regenerated each request/build rather than managed as durable knowledge pages.
Source citations are generated from text chunks, not true PDF page-aware extraction yet.
file:// links may be blocked by browser security, but backend reveal route exists and is more reliable.
API-level toasts can be noisy because GET /api/files and GET /api/wiki also trigger success toasts. If user complains, add a silent option to apiRequest.
do_not_break: Source references remain visible and trustworthy.
Build/test commands in start_all_debug.bat must remain reliable for the user.
